message.content:
You are building the GROWTH ENGINE (coupons, referrals, signup free-credit) for the Nxeon VPS hosting platform at /opt/nxeon. Three OTHER agents are concurrently editing OTHER areas of this same repo, so you must ONLY touch the files listed in YOUR OWNED FILES and nothing else.

## CODEBASE PRIMER
- Next.js 15 App Router + React 19 + Tailwind v4 + Prisma (PostgreSQL). Server Actions live in `lib/actions-*.ts` files marked `"use server"` — such files may ONLY export async functions (put constants/types in a plain module, e.g. `lib/growth.ts`).
- Prisma: `import { db } from "@/lib/db"`. The client is ALREADY generated with these NEW models/fields you can use now:
  - `Coupon { id, code(unique), kind: CouponKind(PERCENT|FIXED_CENTS|CREDIT_CENTS), value:Int, scope: CouponScope(ANY|TOPUP|ORDER), firstTimeOnly:Bool, minAmountCents:Int?, maxRedemptions:Int?, timesRedeemed:Int, expiresAt:DateTime?, active:Bool, note:String? }`
  - `CouponRedemption { couponId, userId, amountCents, context } @@unique([couponId,userId])`
  - `User` new fields: `referralCode String?(unique)`, `referredById String?` + relations `referredBy`/`referrals` (self-relation name "Referrals"), `signupCreditCents Int`, `referralRewardedAt DateTime?`, `couponRedemptions`.
- Auth: `import { currentUser, requireUser, requireAdmin } from "@/lib/auth"`. `requireUser()` returns the logged-in user or redirects. `requireAdmin()` guards admin. Admin RBAC pages use `import { requireArea } from "@/lib/rbac"` then `await requireArea("billing")`.
- Money = integer cents on `User.balanceCents`. To CREDIT a wallet use a transaction: `await db.$transaction([ db.user.update({ where:{id}, data:{ balanceCents:{ increment: cents } } }), db.walletTransaction.create({ data:{ userId:id, amountCents: cents, description } }) ])`. Atomic debit helper exists: `import { debitWallet } from "@/lib/wallet"`.
- Design system (Tailwind classes from globals.css): `.card`, `.btn-primary`, `.btn-secondary`, `.btn-ghost`, `.btn-danger`, `.input`, `.table-shell`. Text uses slate palette (`text-slate-400`), brand accent (`text-brand-300`, `from-brand-400`). Dark premium theme. Primitives: `import { PageHeader, Badge, fmtMoney, timeAgo } from "@/components/ui/primitives"`.
- Study these existing patterns first (READ them): `app/admin/plans/page.tsx` + `components/PlanForm.tsx` (admin CRUD), `components/AdminControls.tsx` (action buttons with server actions), `app/dashboard/settings/page.tsx` (customer page), and READ `lib/actions.ts` fully to find the `register`, `topUp`, and `orderServer` functions you must extend.

## WHAT TO BUILD
1. **Coupons/promo codes**: admins create codes; customers redeem on wallet top-up. Support PERCENT (bonus %), FIXED_CENTS, CREDIT_CENTS (flat wallet credit). Enforce active/expiry/maxRedemptions/firstTimeOnly/minAmount and the `@@unique([couponId,userId])` one-per-user rule.
2. **Referrals**: every user gets a unique `referralCode` (generate on register if missing). A shareable link `${APP_URL}/register?ref=CODE`. When a referred user makes their FIRST successful paid action (top-up or order), credit BOTH the referrer and the new user `REFERRAL_REWARD_CENTS` (env, default 500) once — guard with `referralRewardedAt`.
3. **Signup free-credit**: on register, grant `SIGNUP_FREE_CREDIT_CENTS` (env, default 0 = off) as wallet credit + WalletTransaction, and store on `signupCreditCents`.

Read env with `process.env`. Put constants + pure helpers (referral-code generator using only `crypto`, reward amounts) in the plain module `lib/growth.ts`.

## YOUR OWNED FILES (create/edit ONLY these)
- CREATE `lib/growth.ts` — plain module: `REFERRAL_REWARD_CENTS`, `SIGNUP_FREE_CREDIT_CENTS` getters; `generateReferralCode()`; a `describeCoupon(coupon)` helper.
- CREATE `lib/actions-growth.ts` (`"use server"`) — `applyCouponToTopup(code, baseCents)` returns bonus/validation; `adminCreateCoupon(form)`, `adminToggleCoupon(id)`, `adminDeleteCoupon(id)` (all call `requireAdmin()`); `grantSignupCredit(userId)` and `maybeRewardReferral(userId)` helpers callable from lib/actions.ts.
- CREATE `components/customer/CouponField.tsx` (`"use client"`) — an input to enter a promo code on the top-up flow, shows validated result.
- CREATE `components/customer/ReferralPanel.tsx` — shows the user's referral link (copy button), reward amount, and count of successful referrals.
- CREATE `app/dashboard/refer/page.tsx` — server component: `requireUser()`, ensure they have a referralCode (create if null), render ReferralPanel + a short "how it works".
- CREATE `app/admin/coupons/page.tsx` — `requireArea("billing")`; list coupons in a `.table-shell`, a create form, toggle/delete. Use `components/admin/CouponControls.tsx`.
- CREATE `components/admin/CouponControls.tsx` (`"use client"`) — create/toggle/delete controls wired to the admin actions.
- EDIT `lib/actions.ts` (you are the SOLE editor of this file) — in `register`: generate `referralCode`, capture a referral from a `ref` cookie/param if present (set `referredById`), and call `grantSignupCredit`. In `topUp` (and the Stripe credit path if present): accept an optional coupon code and apply the bonus, then call `maybeRewardReferral`. In `orderServer`: after a successful paid order, call `maybeRewardReferral(userId)`.
- EDIT `app/dashboard/billing/page.tsx` (SOLE editor) — mount `CouponField` near the top-up control and add a small "Refer & earn" CTA linking to `/dashboard/refer`.
- EDIT `app/register/page.tsx` (SOLE editor) — capture `?ref=CODE`: render a tiny client component you create at `components/customer/ReferralCapture.tsx` (also yours to create) that stores the ref in a cookie on mount, so the `register` server action can read it. Do NOT edit `components/AuthForms.tsx`.

## HARD RULES
- NEVER touch: prisma/schema.prisma, next.config.ts, app/layout.tsx, app/globals.css, components/portal/Shell.tsx, components/AuthForms.tsx, lib/auth.ts, lib/db.ts, lib/wallet.ts, ROADMAP.md, docs/**, or ANY file not in your owned list. Other agents own the blog, security/settings, and server/domain pages.
- Do NOT run `npm run build`, `next build`, `prisma db push/migrate/generate`, or restart services. Do NOT git commit/push. Write careful, correctly-typed code and self-review.
- No new npm dependencies.
- `"use server"` files export only async functions.
- For a sidebar nav link to `/dashboard/refer` and `/admin/coupons` (Shell.tsx is forbidden), just note it under INTEGRATION NEEDED.

## FINAL REPORT
Return: files created/edited with one line each; how coupons+referrals+signup-credit work; any INTEGRATION NEEDED (nav links, env vars to set like SIGNUP_FREE_CREDIT_CENTS/REFERRAL_REWARD_CENTS); anything incomplete or risky.

### How it works
- **Coupons:** admins create codes (PERCENT = bonus %, FIXED_CENTS / CREDIT_CENTS = flat extra credit). On top-up, `applyCouponToTopup` enforces active/expiry/scope(TOPUP|ANY)/minAmount/maxRedemptions/firstTimeOnly and the one-per-user `@@unique([couponId,userId])` rule; the bonus is credited on top of the amount added. Redemption + counter increments happen inside `topUp`'s transaction.
- **Referrals:** every user gets a unique `referralCode`; link is `${APP_URL}/register?ref=CODE`. The referred user's first paid action (top-up or order) atomically claims `referralRewardedAt` and credits BOTH parties `REFERRAL_REWARD_CENTS` exactly once (guarded against double-pay via `updateMany`).
- **Signup credit:** `grantSignupCredit` grants `SIGNUP_FREE_CREDIT_CENTS` as wallet credit + WalletTransaction and records it on `signupCreditCents`, once, only when > 0.

### Risks / limitations
- **Coupons apply to the demo top-up path only.** The real Stripe credit path lives in `lib/stripe.ts` (`creditCheckoutSession`), which is outside my owned files, so it does not consume the `nxeon_coupon` cookie or apply bonuses. If coupons should work with live card top-ups, that file's owner needs to wire in the bonus + `maybeRewardReferral`. (Note: `topUp`'s demo path is itself hard-disabled whenever Stripe is configured.)
- **`firstTimeOnly`** is interpreted as "user has no prior positive WalletTransaction" (never credited before).
- Minor best-effort races (maxRedemptions checked then incremented; per-user redemption checked then created) are acceptable and additionally backstopped by the DB unique constraint.
